tasks.title: PostToolUse hook: plan-mode markers and AskUserQuestion round ledger
tasks.objective: Add the hook script, its dispatcher entry, two schemas and the settings wiring so that plan-mode writes and AskUserQuestion rounds are recorded per story; no recorder behaviour changes yet.
acceptance_criteria: forge hook post_tool_use records <scope>/plan-mode/<uuid>.json with path (absolute, may be outside the repo such as ~/.claude/plans/x.md), sha256 (raw bytes), sha256_body (plan_digest_without_assumptions), at, session_id ('' when absent), generated_by 'claude-code:plan-mode' for Write/Edit/MultiEdit made with permission_mode plan, and nothing for other modes; root-level dirs are used when no story is active

the same hook records <scope>/grill-rounds/<uuid>.json with questions (question, options, chosen — chosen null when tool_response is absent or not among the options), at, session_id ('' when absent), generated_by 'claude-code:plan-mode' for every AskUserQuestion whose tool_input.questions is usable; unparseable input exits 0 without writing
both record kinds validate against new schemas; .claude/settings.json wires PostToolUse for Write|Edit|MultiEdit|AskUserQuestion; gate tests cover both record kinds and the fail-open path

tasks.title: plan save, plan approve, task plan save and task approve require a plan-mode marker
tasks.objective: Make the story and task plan recorders refuse any plan file whose digest was not written in plan mode, so plans authored from normal mode cannot be saved or approved.
acceptance_criteria: require_plan_mode_marker refuses when no marker in the active story scope OR the root scope matches the file digest excluding the Implementation Assumptions block (story scope searched first, then root); plan save, plan approve, task plan save and task approve all call it
gate tests prove refusal without a marker and success with one for both story and task plans

tasks.title: Grill recorder requires logged rounds, per-gate floors, frontier_empty, and a saved task plan; frontier order flipped
tasks.objective: Make grills provable: rounds must match the AskUserQuestion ledger, meet the per-gate floor, end with a frontier_empty attestation, and a task grill needs its task plan first; forge next prints the enforced order.
acceptance_criteria: record_grill_from_json refuses, for spec/requirements/plan/task gates, rounds that do not match a logged record, counts below spec 2 / requirements 1 / plan 2 / task 1, and a final round without frontier_empty true; byte-identical re-records may reuse rounds

a task grill is refused when task-plans/<id>.md is absent, with a one-time tolerance for grills older than a later-saved task plan; task_frontier_state and tasks.cmd_plan_save implement author-task-plan before grill; forge next prints the enforced planning and implementing order
existing inverse-order gate tests are flipped, new refusal and happy-path tests pass
